## Pull request overview

Removes `apps/studio`’s hard dependency on the example app packages by switching MSW/test bootstrapping to load a single local `objectstack.config.ts` and updating tests to match the new (non-namespaced) object naming.

**Changes:**
- Removed `@example/app-crm` / `@example/app-todo` from Studio dependencies (and lockfile importer entry).
- Updated MSW browser + node simulation boot to use Studio’s own `objectstack.config.ts` instead of hardcoded example package imports.
- Updated Studio’s local config (fields + seed data) and adjusted tests from `todo__task` → `task`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Removes example app dependencies from the studio importer entry. |
| apps/studio/package.json | Drops example app packages from runtime dependencies. |
| apps/studio/src/mocks/browser.ts | Boots MSW browser kernel from `apps/studio/objectstack.config.ts`. |
| apps/studio/src/mocks/simulateBrowser.ts | Boots MSW node simulation from `apps/studio/objectstack.config.ts`. |
| apps/studio/objectstack.config.ts | Adds select fields + seed data so Studio can run standalone in MSW mode. |
| apps/studio/test/verify-metadata.test.ts | Updates assertions to use `task` object name. |
| apps/studio/test/verify-dom.test.ts | Updates assertions to use `task` object name. |
</details>


<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>
Missing comma after the `priority` field definition. The closing `}` should be followed by a comma to separate it from the next `category` field, otherwise the `fields` object won't parse.

Missing comma after the `status` field definition. Without `},` after the closing brace, the `fields` object is invalid TypeScript/JavaScript and will fail to compile.
```suggestion
      ],
```
